mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have heavy rain hitting Reddan Soccer Park, so plan for a wet morning. If you are looking at the sky tonight, catch the space station at 7:36 PM as it crosses from the west over Mount Horeb toward the northeast near Home Depot, climbing halfway up the sky.

The Verona Police Department released a summary of incidents from late August through early September, noting a significant burglary on September 10 on Hunters Cove Way where a suspect was taken into custody after a firearm was discharged.
There is a lot happening in the city, with Hop Haus Trivia hosting games today, and tomorrow bringing the Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.
On September 10, Verona officers responded to an in-progress burglary on Hunters Cove Way, which resulted in the arrest of a 19-year-old male and the recovery of a handgun.
Culver's is currently getting ready for the day and will open today at 10:00 AM to serve up your favorites.
